title: Talarico warms to Trump, says he wants to help fulfill some MAGA promises
summary: James Talarico told the "Diary of a CEO" podcast he'd work with Trump on healthcare, housing and childcare despite months of attacks from the president.

title: Trump says Israel will stop receiving $4B in US aid by year's end, can still buy weapons
summary: President Donald Trump says Benjamin Netanyahu raised the idea of ending $4 billion in U.S. military aid to Israel by the end of the year.

title: Federal judge tosses Trump admin Harvard admissions lawsuit, leaves door open to future challenge
summary: A federal judge dismissed the Trump administration's lawsuit against Harvard University over admissions records, citing procedural deficiencies.

title: Mamdani threatens to sue Trump admin over ICE's use of city-owned lots for immigration enforcement
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani threatened legal action against ICE over agents allegedly staging immigration enforcement operations in city-owned parking lots.

title: Spanish soccer player Jesús de Miguel dies after on-field collision as authorities open investigation
summary: Jesús de Miguel suffered cardiac arrest after a brutal collision with FC Andorra's goalkeeper during injury time of a match on Tenerife's home pitch.

title: Joe Rogan warns 'woke' ideology is replacing God on the left and entering into Christianity
summary: Podcaster Joe Rogan argued woke ideology has become a replacement for religion, with LGBT pastors inserting non-biblical ideas into Christianity.

title: Jerry Jones calls for Cowboys star player to see the ball more after crushing overtime defeat
summary: Jerry Jones said George Pickens needs more targets after the Dallas Cowboys star played just 42 of 74 snaps in the overtime loss to Arizona.

title: Christa Pike asks court not to send her to former prison block following failed execution
summary: Christa Pike claims her life is in danger if moved back to her former housing unit, citing severe weakness after surviving the botched lethal injection.

title: WATCH: Repeat offender leads deputies on 100 mph chase before hiding under porch in his underwear
summary: Video captures Zakary Dean Hirschfield's 100 mph chase through Douglas County before deputies found him hiding beneath a porch in his underwear.

title: Two helicopters collide near Mount Everest during rescue flight, killing one, injuring others
summary: A tourist died after two helicopters collided near Pheriche below Mount Everest base camp. A 47-year-old man who was killed was from Chennai, India.
